inspiration: Floating damage digits are laid out glyph by glyph with each advance averaged against its neighbour, then centred by half the total width (Gameplay/Combat/DamageNumber.cpp lines 26-82, centring at line 68).
Critical hits use a taller stacking row (36 vs 30 px, DamageNumber.cpp line 189). Several hits on one target stack upward from the head position (Gameplay/Combat/Combat.cpp lines 385-398).

Float-and-fade: numbers rise at a fixed speed, start above full opacity and lose a fixed step per update (DamageNumber.cpp lines 78-79, 181-182; Constants.h line 29; DamageNumber.h line 53). About 94 updates to fade, roughly 0.75 s at an 8 ms step (derived by me).
Death: the mob plays its die clip, the dead flag is set only when that clip ends (Gameplay/MapleMap/Mob.cpp line 153), then the sprite fades down by a fixed step per update (Mob.cpp line 158).
Ground patrol: a non-flying mob turns once at each footing edge; a hit-stunned mob that turns drops out of the hit clip (Mob.cpp lines 197-198).
Afterimage trail: the frame at which the trail starts is read from data (Character/Look/Afterimage.cpp line 47) and the trail draws only from that frame on (lines 65-66). A frame gate, not a timer.
Named UI sound table: UI sounds are fetched by name from one group and played by name (Audio/Audio.cpp lines 77-79). Shape worth copying for HUD feedback.
Stance-as-clip: a creature is a set of named clips (stand, move, jump, hit1, die1) picked by a stance value (Mob.cpp lines 62-73). Clean shape for our creature actor.

briefs.label: Stacked float digits (damage feed)
briefs.why: Readable at 375 wide, one signature effect: numbers pop, stack upward and fade. Critical rows are visibly taller, so a crit reads without a sound.
briefs.keep: KEPT: stacking upward per hit line; taller row for critical; centred number; fixed rise and fade.
briefs.change: CHANGED: our own glyph set and tint per source (self, incoming, other); a short bounce on crits; a different row height and fade curve, so it is not the donor's look.

briefs.label: Edge-turning ground critter
briefs.why: Readable silhouette, one signature behaviour (walks, turns at a ledge, a hit makes it stop turning and flinch). Works in a fast fight as a simple patrol.
briefs.keep: KEPT: turn once per edge; a hit clip ends the hit when the critter turns; clip-named stance states.
briefs.change: CHANGED: a different body plan (low, wide, armoured with a visible tail), a turn pause with a head-look, and our own clip names and timing; never the donor's sprite.

briefs.label: Sinking fade on death
briefs.why: Death is bearable: the body plays its clip, then sinks and fades rather than blinking out. One signature presentation.
briefs.keep: KEPT: die clip must finish before the fade starts; a fixed fade step per update.
briefs.change: CHANGED: a dust or ember sink instead of an opacity fade; a short hold before the sink; a different fade time.

briefs.label: Frame-gated afterimage trail
briefs.why: A skill trail that reads as motion without particles: the trail begins at a set point in the attack, not at a timer.
briefs.keep: KEPT: trail starts at a data-set frame of the caster's animation and draws only from there.
briefs.change: CHANGED: our trail is a ribbon of three ghost poses in a cool palette; the start frame is per skill, in our own data table.
